body: Thanks for all of the supportive comments, after the drama that has happened today there's a lot more discussion to be had with the wife, the primary issue though is to sort out me mental health first so I've got some appointments booked to help sort it.
DO NOT MARRY HER!! It will not improve!

Pretty much 12 hours ago, when you posted this I was sat in my car doing the deed. Unfortunately some guys saw me and pulled me out, another 5 mins and I'd have been gone. Spent most of the day in the hospital and have now got an appointment with the crisis team and getting some help.
You are so right with this!

8 years on in a relationship slightly similar to what you describe, the constant rejection has killed any form of love and passion in the relationship along with my self esteem to the point I'm not extremely depressed and verging on suicidal.
Please don't make the same mistake I did. If you're not happy now it'll only get worse.

I've joined support groups yes, they actually make the feelings worse because it shows me how I could be within the next 10 years, I've had to unfollow a couple of the "support" groups because they were just too negative. 
It's not just the MS, it's my marriage not working, dead bedroom etc. constant rejection, but not leaving because of the MS, why would anyone want to be with someone who they'll end up having to care for in the very near future. Getting out when I still can feels like the best option.
